features.feature: Edit contact (name, company, phone, email, address, notes)
Add Field (birthday, nickname, job title, department, URL, related names, dates, profiles, pronouns, phonetic)
features.note: built on parity/team-d-contacts; not yet verified on Midget; nine single-valued fields (nickname, job title, department, URL, birthday, pronouns, phonetic name, related name, profile), read and written in vCards, saved in details.txt
features.wire: Allow several labelled values for dates, related names and profiles (with a service), and let the person reorder fields.

features.feature: Groups: new, rename, delete, add/remove members
features.apple: File > New Group; Edit > Rename List, Remove From List

features.feature: Multi-select and New Group from Selection
features.note: Card > Select Contacts marks rows and New Group From Selection adds the marked contacts to a group through the kit model contact_groups (contacts.rs:1948). Gap: a press has no Shift or Command modifier, so there is no range or extend selection yet (contacts.rs:1926).
features.wire: Add Shift/Cmd multi-select to the list and New Group From Selection backed by contact_groups.

features.apple: File > New Smart List; Edit Smart List
features.note: built on parity/team-d-contacts; not yet verified on Midget; File > New Smart List editor with up to six rules (name, company, phone, email, address, notes) joined by all or any, saved in smartlists.txt
features.wire: Add rules on groups, favorites and card fields, nested conditions, and a sheet in place of the detail pane.

features.apple: Card > Look for Duplicates, Merge Selected Cards; ABDuplicateReviewSheet.nib
features.note: Card > Merge Duplicates merges the open card with its twins (dupes.rs:117); no review sheet, group membership of merged cards is dropped
features.wire: Add a review sheet that lets the person pick the value to keep for each field before merging.

features.apple: File > Import; ABImportPanel.nib; Info.plist vCard type

features.note: File > Import reads CSV, TSV and LDIF files from the Import folder through textimport.rs, with host tests in that module (contacts.rs:2017). Gap: no column-mapping review sheet yet, and the separate tabular.rs model is not called by the app.
features.wire: Add CSV and LDIF to File > Import; show the column-mapping review sheet from tabular::guess_columns before tabular::import_csv, then assign ids and save like the vCard import.

features.feature: Print and Export as PDF (list, labels, envelopes)
features.apple: File > Print, Export as PDF; ABPrintPanel, ABLabelPrinting, ABEnvelopePrinting nibs
features.note: built on parity/team-d-contacts; not yet verified on Midget; the list, one card and address labels as plain text pages through the print service; PDF saved in the Export folder; no envelope layout
features.wire: Add label sheet and envelope layouts, a print panel with options, and styled list pages.

features.note: built on parity/team-d-contacts; not yet verified on Midget; File > Export Contacts Archive writes contacts.bcarchive; Restore from Archive reads the newest one in the Import folder after a second confirmation and puts the old data back if it does not read
features.wire: Use save and open panels in place of the Export and Import folders.

features.feature: My Card (make this my card, go to my card)
features.apple: Card > Make This My Card, Go to My Card
features.note: Card menu Make This My Card / Go to My Card, saved in mycard.txt; no marker on the list row
features.wire: Share My Card, and use the card as the sender identity in Mail.

features.note: Card menu item and edit form switch; the card and list row show the company as the title with a building avatar, and the list sorts and sections a company by its company name (host test a_company_sorts_by_its_company_name_in_the_list). Not yet verified on Midget.
features.wire: Sort companies by company name in the list.

features.apple: Card > Choose Custom Image, Clear Custom Image
features.note: Audit 2026-10-13: kit model ui/src/contact_photo.rs (host tests) already provides this; the app does not use it yet.
features.wire: Store an image per contact beside its record, set from an open panel on the edit-form avatar.

features.note: Card > Go to Next/Previous Card with cmd+] / cmd+[, stepping along the shown list and stopping at the ends (host test next_and_previous_card_step_along_the_list_and_stop_at_the_ends); the key equivalents are not yet checked on Midget
features.wire: Check on Midget that the key equivalents reach the menu items.

features.apple: Card > Open in Separate Window; ABContactCardWindowController.nib
features.note: The SDK window registry exists: open, close, focus, ids that are never reused, routing by window id. The Contacts card model (one card per window, a card already open is focused) is written and tested headless. Not done: the shell does not host a second window of an app, so the card window has no surface and is not on screen; Card > Open in Separate Window and the double-click are not wired.
features.wire: Draw the card in the second window once the shell hosts extra windows, then wire Card > Open in Separate Window and the double-click to CardWindows::open_card.

features.note: built on parity/team-d-contacts; not yet verified on Midget; Prefer Nicknames only
features.wire: Add the short name style, address format and default account rows.

features.note: built on parity/team-d-contacts; not yet verified on Midget; Settings > Fields a New Card Shows; the form of a new card shows those card fields
